$comment: Named Foundry server profiles for the MCP server. The desktop app manages this schema through Edit > Server Connections and stores it at %APPDATA%/FoundryVTT MCP Bridge/foundry-servers.json. Headless installs can copy this file next to the server or set FOUNDRY_SERVERS_CONFIG. Each profile needs a unique port; the module settings in each Foundry world must point at that profile's port. WebRTC signaling uses port + 1. authToken must match the module's browser-local Bridge Auth Token and is strongly recommended for browser-hosted worlds. Forge on the same workstation uses loopback (remoteMode false); remoteMode true is only for browsers on another machine and requires a long token plus firewall protection. Unset fields inherit from environment variables (FOUNDRY_HOST, FOUNDRY_PORT, ...).
